# Rakuten Viki

> > Rakuten Viki is a global streaming platform specializing in K-Dramas, Chinese Dramas, J-Dramas, and other Asian content with community-powered subtitles.

Viki offers curated collections of Korean, Chinese, and Japanese dramas organized by romance tropes, themes, actors like Park Min Young and Cha Eun Woo, and viewing occasions. The platform serves as a hub for Asian entertainment with beginner-friendly guides and culturally significant collections celebrating Asian and Pacific Islander Heritage.

## Key Topics

## Getting Started

- [New to Viki - Start Here](https://www.viki.com/collections/2976669l-new-to-viki-start-here): New user guide with curated K-Drama and streaming recommendations
- [J-Drama Beginners](https://www.viki.com/collections/3501193l-j-drama-beginners): Beginner's guide to J-Drama with Japanese drama recommendations
- [More Stories That Bring Us Together](https://www.viki.com/collections/3018221l-more-stories-that-bring-us-together): Asian Pacific Islander Heritage Month curated drama collection

## Romance Collections

- [Rich x Poor Romance](https://www.viki.com/collections/3532731l-rich-x-poor-romance): Rich-poor romance trope collection with K-Dramas and Chinese Dramas
- [Friends to Lovers](https://www.viki.com/collections/3173085l-friends-to-lovers): Friends-to-lovers romance trope Korean and Chinese drama collection
- [Secret Crush on You](https://www.viki.com/collections/3654132l-secret-crush-on-you): Secret crush romance K-Drama curated playlist
- [Will You Marry Me](https://www.viki.com/collections/3789549l-will-you-marry-me): Fake marriage and romantic comedy K-Drama collection
- [Fairytale Romances](https://www.viki.com/collections/3527897l-fairytale-romances): Fairytale romance K-Dramas and Asian drama collection
- [Vacation Romance](https://www.viki.com/collections/3798507l-vacation-romance): Vacation romance K-Dramas set in exotic locations

## Thematic Collections

- [Flower Boys](https://www.viki.com/collections/3570398l-flower-boys): Curated collection of flower boys K-Dramas and Korean shows
- [Songs and Stories](https://www.viki.com/collections/3148746l-songs-and-stories): Music-themed dramas featuring K-pop idols and musician stories
- [Revenge and Satisfaction](https://www.viki.com/collections/3757532l-revenge-and-satisfaction): Revenge-themed K-Dramas and Chinese Dramas collection
- [Pulled into the Unknown](https://www.viki.com/collections/4025952l-pulled-into-the-unknown): Fantasy dramas featuring time-travel and body-swap themes
- [Winter Wonderland](https://www.viki.com/collections/2934286l-winter-wonderland): Seasonal winter-themed K-Drama and Chinese Drama collection
- [Memorable Dramas](https://www.viki.com/collections/3550029l-memorable-dramas): Classic memorable dramas from early 2000s library collection

## Actor Collections

- [Park Min Young - Dramas, Movies & TV Shows](https://www.viki.com/collections/3045542l-park-min-young-dramas-movies-tv-shows): Park Min Young actress collection of Korean dramas and TV shows
- [Cha Eun Woo - Dramas, Movies & TV Shows](https://www.viki.com/collections/3236123l-cha-eun-woo-dramas-movies-tv-shows): Cha Eun Woo K-pop idol actor collection of Korean dramas
